# An error on a field chained to a parenthesized pipeline is located at the
# field and reported with the parenthesized pipeline as context, as
# text/template renders the chain.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
! muxt check
stderr -count=1 'template.gohtml:2:15: executing "GET / Index\(\)" at <\(\.Result\)\.Missing>: field or method Missing not found on Data$'
stderr -count=1 'template.gohtml:3:16: executing "GET / Index\(\)" at <\(\.Result\.Tag\)\.Len>: field or method Len not found on string$'
stderr -count=1 'template.gohtml:4:15: executing "GET / Index\(\)" at <\(\.Result\)\.Missing\.X>: field or method Missing not found on Data$'
stderr -count=1 'template.gohtml:5:24: executing "GET / Index\(\)" at <\(\$x\)\.Gone>: field or method Gone not found on Data$'

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<p>{{(.Result).Missing}}</p>
{{(.Result.Tag).Len}}
{{ ( .Result ).Missing.X }}
{{$x := .Result}}{{($x).Gone}}
{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*"))

type T struct{}

type Data struct {
	Tag string
}

func (T) Index() Data { return Data{} }
